title: Practice 15: Where: над, под, за, перед, между

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Слева, над ___ (предгорья) Монте-Альбано, лиловыми и нежными, дрожала одинокая звезда.
exercises.why: Like the other cases, there are prepositions which can place whatever comes after them in the instrumental case. There are six in total: **С(о), над, под, за, перед**, and **между**. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.
exercises.context: Like the other cases, there are prepositions which can place whatever comes after them in the instrumental case. (From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0))
